dogecoin.text: Let's leave traces, not let them leave traces on us. What will crush blockchain? Transfers without internet, you already know, and I'm the one who can do it. Dogecoin will always be there.

I am a guy who invents and has ideas. I am a magnet. Money will always come to me because I really didn't look for it. I asked for it. Can you imagine going to space? Somehow you're going to have to pay for that, baby, and it will be in dogecoin.

I really made a contribution to the crypto world that wasn't necessary. And they didn't value it because if I have to be guided by my own ethical criteria, I would really tell them that the future is dogecoin and I would even eliminate bitcoin itself.
